card.name: Meshrep
card.tagline: Uyghur communal gathering of muqam music, dance and moral counsel
card.profile: Meshrep (Uyghur: مەشرەپ; Chinese 麦西热甫) is a traditional Uyghur gathering combining poetry, muqam music, dance, games and moral adjudication, found chiefly in Xinjiang (English Wikipedia; UNESCO). Men play progressively faster muqam on the dutar while participants compete at whirling circle dances; it functions as both a 'classroom' and a 'court'. UNESCO notes all Uyghur people may participate.
card.insight: Inscribed in 2010 on UNESCO's List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in Need of Urgent Safeguarding (ref 00304), Meshrep is the most important cultural carrier of Uyghur tradition (UNESCO).
